stem: A room's programmed photoperiod is correct, but an unintended light source intermittently interrupts the dark period. What should be investigated first?
choices: Whether the dark-period interruption is altering the intended photoperiodic signal
Whether the crop received enough nutrients to maintain normal reproductive development during the same period
Whether canopy PPFD remains sufficiently uniform during the scheduled light period to explain the observed response
Whether the harvest timeline should be adjusted before the light interruption is corrected so later development stays on schedule
rationale: An unintended dark-period light exposure can change the photoperiodic signal even when the programmed on/off schedule appears correct, so the interruption should be verified and corrected before attributing effects elsewhere.
